policy_memory_must_not_reach_evidence.question: Does asked-context memory change what counts as evidence?
policy_memory_must_not_reach_evidence.result: NO. Standing is the identical verdict before and after the repair on both scenarios: every-answer-unplaced -> DECLARED, counted contexts {THIS_CONVERSATION}, identity_admissible False; one-WORK-placement-rest-unplaced -> CORROBORATED via ADMISSION_RULE_SATISFIED on {THIS_CONVERSATION, WORK}, identity_admissible still False.
policy_memory_must_not_reach_evidence.conclusion: Asked-memory changed which question comes next and nothing about what counts. The separation the repair claims is real.

exhaustion.question: What happens once every openable context has been asked for a signal?
exhaustion.result: No RECURRENCE probe is generated, no other objective is licensed, and the conversation ends on NO_LEGAL_OBJECTIVE.
exhaustion.conclusion: Honest termination rather than a loop or an invented probe — the same failure direction the coverage harness uses when it reports NO_CORPUS.

unseen_questions_must_not_burn_a_context.question: Can a context be marked asked when the node never saw the question?
unseen_questions_must_not_burn_a_context.result: NO. PROVOKE_REFUSED records neither signal_id nor proposed_life_context, and asked_contexts() requires both to be present.
unseen_questions_must_not_burn_a_context.conclusion: Correct by construction rather than by intent. A question that was never presented cannot consume a life domain.

findings.severity: RESIDUAL — not a regression, and not a coverage defect
findings.title: Remaining repeated questions are cross-signal, and indistinguishable to the node
findings.observed: In a long unplaced run, 10 RECURRENCE probes yielded 8 distinct sentences. The two repeats are FAMILY_OF_ORIGIN and INTIMATE, each asked once for sig_0001 and once for sig_0002.
findings.assessment: Semantically correct. Probing a DIFFERENT pattern in the same life domain is a genuinely different question, and asked-memory is correctly scoped per signal.
findings.the_actual_problem: The sentence is byte-identical — 'Does that same thing show up in the family you grew up in?' — with nothing indicating WHICH same thing. The node hears the identical question twice and cannot tell that it refers to a different pattern.
findings.attribution: This is F-008 surfacing, not a defect in the F-013 repair. No probe names the pattern it is probing, because no probe quotes the node.
findings.consequence: F-008 is now the load-bearing open item. It was previously described as a quality gap and a detector-reachability gap; it is now also the reason a correct behaviour reads as a bug.

first_contact_readiness.technical_blockers: NONE REMAINING. The pipeline executes, refuses to run out of order, speaks back through authorized revelation only, lets the node own context placement, and no longer repeats a probe within a signal.
what_is_not_a_blocker_but_should_be_weig: F-008 — SELF still never quotes the node. A person will hear the same sentence for two different patterns (F-015), and the two most-developed E3 rules remain structurally unprovokable, so any recall measured from this session will be a fact about the probe policy.
F-014 — the fixture never exercises the default human path across cycles, so what the proof run certifies and what a human will meet are still different paths.
first_contact_readiness.the_one_session_argument: The first session happens once and permanently joins the discovery partition, so it can never later serve as independent validation. Whatever the probe policy is on the day, that is what the first on-distribution corpus records.

next_authority.act_required: Run the first ConsciousConversation session, or first decide F-008. There is no longer a technical reason to wait; there is a judgement about whether the first and permanently-discovery corpus should be produced by a runtime that never says the node's words back.
